title: Question classification dataset
summary:
This dataset is used to train models for predicting the topics of questions based on 
    their summaries and categories. This JSON dataset has been created by querying the CLOSER 
    repository REST API using https://github.com/CLOSER-Cohorts/colectica-api.

id.name: AgencyId
id.description: Value of the agency id for a study in CLOSER

target.name: Topic
target.description:
A string identifying a topic belonging to the topics ontology defined by 
        CLOSER. These strings can be either 3 characters long (indicating a high-level topic) or 
        5 characters long (indicating a more specific lower-level topic).

features.name: Summary
features.description: A free text string describing a question

features.name: QuestionCategories
features.description: A list of strings representing categorical values associated with a question.
